capabilities: Navigate a note as a tree of aligned heading cards with expand/collapse
Drag cards to reorder sections, move branches, or reparent headings with automatic heading-level rewrites
Expand sections into text-block cards separated by empty lines and drag blocks within or between sections
Edit cards with an embedded CodeMirror editor or open the section in Obsidian's standard editor
Treat MARP documents (marp: true) as flat, draggable slide cards
disambiguation: Not a flashcard or spaced-repetition tool; its 'cards' are visual sections of a Markdown note.
extras: Desktop only. README warns it is an early beta and advises backing up notes; it is under active development and interactions may change. The author notes it was built iteratively with AI assistance.
problem: Obsidian's editor shows a note as one linear text file, which makes navigating and restructuring long, heading-heavy documents awkward.

relations.evidence: Treat an explicit MARP document (marp: true) as a flat sequence of draggable slide cards

summary: Visual card editor that renders a Markdown note as a navigable hierarchy of draggable section cards that edit the same source file.
